org: jesusflores123
app: zazu-update
service: odoo-zazu

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: python3.12
  region: us-east-1
  stage: ${opt:stage, 'dev'}
  memorySize: 256
  timeout: 29
  logRetentionInDays: 14
  environment:
    NOTIFICATIONS_TABLE: zazu-notifications-prod
    VALIDATIONS_TABLE: zazu-validations-prod
    SCREENSHOTS_BUCKET: zazu-screenshots-prod
    WHATSAPP_TOKEN: ${ssm:/zazu2/odoo_whatsapp_token, ''}
    ODOO_CALLBACK_URL: ${ssm:/zazu2/odoo_callback_url, ''}
    ODOO_CALLBACK_TOKEN: ${ssm:/zazu2/odoo_callback_token, ''}

  iam:
    role:
      statements:
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - dynamodb:Query
            - dynamodb:Scan
            - dynamodb:GetItem
            - dynamodb:PutItem
            - dynamodb:UpdateItem
            - dynamodb:DeleteItem
            - dynamodb:DescribeTable
          Resource:
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${aws:region}:${aws:accountId}:table/zazu-validations-prod
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${aws:region}:${aws:accountId}:table/zazu-validations-prod/index/*
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${aws:region}:${aws:accountId}:table/zazu-notifications-prod
            - arn:aws:dynamodb:${aws:region}:${aws:accountId}:table/zazu-notifications-prod/index/*

        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - s3:GetObject
            - s3:PutObject
            - s3:DeleteObject
            - s3:ListBucket
          Resource:
            - arn:aws:s3:::zazu-screenshots-prod
            - arn:aws:s3:::zazu-screenshots-prod/*

        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - textract:DetectDocumentText
            - textract:AnalyzeDocument
          Resource: "*"

        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - lambda:InvokeFunction
          Resource:
            - arn:aws:lambda:${aws:region}:${aws:accountId}:function:${self:service}-${sls:stage}-*

custom:
  prune:
    automatic: true
    number: 3

functions:
  # ===== VALIDACION (Usan validation_handler.py) =====
  validateFromOdoo:
    handler: validation_handler.validate_from_odoo
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /validate-from-odoo
          method: post
    timeout: 29

  processWhatsAppImage:
    handler: validation_handler.process_whatsapp_image
    timeout: 29

  processScreenshot:
    handler: validation_handler.process_screenshot
    timeout: 29

  getDuplicateValidations:
    handler: validation_handler.get_duplicate_validations
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /validations/duplicates
          method: get

  validatePayment:
    handler: validation_handler.validate_payment
    timeout: 29

  getValidations:
    handler: validation_handler.get_validations
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /validations
          method: get

  getValidationById:
    handler: validation_handler.get_validation_by_id
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /validations/{id}
          method: get

  getPendingValidations:
    handler: validation_handler.get_pending_validations
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /validations/pending
          method: get

  manualReview:
    handler: validation_handler.manual_review
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /validations/{id}/review
          method: put

package:
  patterns:
    - '!node_modules/**'
    - '!.venv/**'
    - '!.git/**'
    - '!.idea/**'
    - '!__pycache__/**'
